effect.name: GM Edge Matte Builder
effect.desc: Builds adjustable inner/outer edge mattes from alpha or luma, with composite-safe default output.
effect.shader: float m(vec4 c){float l=dot(c.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));if(sourceMode==0)return c.a;if(sourceMode==1)return l;return max(c.a,l);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float center=m(src),mn=center,mx=center;for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float a=float(i)*.3926991;float v=m(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*widthPx/sz,0.0,1.0)));mn=min(mn,v);mx=max(mx,v);}float edge=clamp(mx-mn,0.0,1.0),shape=mix(center,expand>=0.0?mx:mn,abs(expand));float matte=smoothstep(0.0,max(softness,.001),max(edge,shape*abs(expand)));if(invert)matte=1.0-matte;vec4 dst;if(outputMode==1)dst=vec4(vec3(matte),1.0);else if(outputMode==2)dst=vec4(src.rgb,matte);else dst=vec4(mix(src.rgb,edgeColor.rgb,matte*edgeColor.a),max(src.a,matte*edgeColor.a));gl_FragColor=mix(src,dst,mixAmount);}
